evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Directive establishes a recurring future cadence and frames an unrehearsed rollback as a hypothetical gap — a general principle rather than a specific event.
Labels a planned recurring activity tied to a named system, pointing at future scheduled practice with a concrete artifact.
Assigns a named individual as current owner — a settled present fact about a specific person.
